project_type: Vite 6 + React 18 + TypeScript + TanStack Router + Convex backend + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui PWA
build_system: bun (npm NOT available). vite for frontend bundling, convex for backend functions.
test_framework: vitest with jsdom (jsdom/bun incompatibility in sandbox - TypeScript build passing is primary verification)
test_command: bun run build (TypeScript compilation is the verification since vitest has sandbox issues)
verification_instructions: 1. Run `bun run build` - must pass (tsc && vite build). 2. Run `bun run lint` - must not exceed 71 problems (current baseline).
setup_instructions: bun install (dependencies already installed in workspace)
environment_constraints: npm NOT available - use bun. jsdom/bun test incompatibility - rely on TypeScript build for verification. Convex backend deploys via GitHub Actions on merge.
contribution_requirements: Branch: fix/r5-notifications from main. Single commit: 'fix: notification reliability and honest opt-in flow (#45, #46)'. bun run build must pass. bun run lint must not go above 71 problems.
key_patterns: shadcn/ui Dialog component at src/components/ui/dialog.tsx. Toast via useToast hook from src/hooks/use-toast. Bell icon subscription in StationCard and $id.tsx. Notification service in src/services/notificationService.ts uses OneSignal SDK + localStorage. useStationSubscription hook wraps subscribe/unsubscribe. Convex mutations in convex/sync/waterLevelUpdater.ts, actions in convex/notifications.ts.
directory_structure: src/components/ - React components. src/hooks/ - custom hooks. src/services/ - service layer (notificationService). src/routes/ - TanStack Router file-based routes. src/utils/ - utility functions. src/components/ui/ - shadcn/ui primitives. convex/ - Convex backend (mutations, actions, queries). convex/sync/ - data sync logic.
